ip_configurations.title: Ip Configurations
ip_configurations.description: A map of ip configurations for the network interface. The map key is deliberately arbitrary to avoid issues where map keys maybe unknown at plan time.
ip_configurations.tfType:
map(object({
    name                                               = string
    gateway_load_balancer_frontend_ip_configuration_id = optional(string, null)
    subnet_id                                          = string
    private_ip_address_version                         = optional(string, "IPv4")
    private_ip_address_allocation                      = optional(string, "Dynamic")
    public_ip_address_id                               = optional(string, null)
    primary                                            = optional(bool, null)
    private_ip_address                                 = optional(string, null)
  }))

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the network interface.

application_gateway_backend_address_pool.title: Application Gateway Backend Address Pool Association
application_gateway_backend_address_pool.description: An object describing the application gateway to associate with the resource. This includes the following properties: - `application_gateway_backend_address_pool_id` - The resource ID of the application gateway backend address pool. - `ip_configuration_name` - The name of the network interface IP configuration.

internal_dns_name_label.title: Internal Dns Name Label
internal_dns_name_label.description: (Optional) The (relative) DNS Name used for internal communications between virtual machines in the same virtual network.

ip_forwarding_enabled.title: Ip Forwarding Enabled
ip_forwarding_enabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether IP forwarding should be enabled on the network interface or not.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Map of tags to assign to the network interface.

location.title: Location
location.description: The Azure location where the network interface should exist.

dns_servers.title: Dns Servers
dns_servers.description: (Optional) Specifies a list of IP addresses representing DNS servers.

edge_zone.title: Edge Zone
edge_zone.description: (Optional) Specifies the extended location of the network interface.

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>. If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

network_security_group_ids.title: Network Security Group Ids
network_security_group_ids.description: (Optional) List of network security group IDs.

resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the network interface.

accelerated_networking_enabled.title: Accelerated Networking Enabled
accelerated_networking_enabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether accelerated networking should be enabled on the network interface or not.

application_security_group_ids.title: Application Security Group Ids
application_security_group_ids.description: (Optional) List of application security group IDs.

load_balancer_backend_address_pool_assoc.title: Load Balancer Backend Address Pool Association
load_balancer_backend_address_pool_assoc.description: A map of object describing the load balancer to associate with the resource. This includes the following properties: - `load_balancer_backend_address_pool_id` - The resource ID of the load balancer backend address pool. - `ip_configuration_name` - The name of the network interface IP configuration.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Controls the Resource Lock configuration for this resource. The following properties can be specified:  - `kind` - (Required) The type of lock. Possible values are `\"CanNotDelete\"` and `\"ReadOnly\"`. - `name` - (Optional) The name of the lock. If not specified, a name will be generated based on the `kind` value. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.

nat_rule_association.title: Nat Rule Association
nat_rule_association.description: A map describing the NAT rule to associate with the resource. This includes the following properties: - `nat_rule_id` - The resource ID of the NAT rule. - `ip_configuration_name` - The name of the network interface IP configuration.
